description: PAID ($0.0018 USDC via x402). Resolve a title or a few words to a Wikipedia article (en, ar, de, fr, es, it, ja, zh, ru, pt, nl, pl, tr, fa, he, ko, id, uk, sv, vi, hi) and return its summary: lead section as plain text (not the whole article), description, URL, last edit, image, coordinates, Wikidata id, how it was matched, other matches. Disambiguation pages are labelled. No fitting title answers 404 and is not charged. Text is CC BY-SA 4.0, attribution included. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

lang.description: Wikipedia language edition (default en): en, ar, de, fr, es, it, ja, zh, ru, pt, nl, pl, tr, fa, he, ko, id, uk, sv, vi, hi

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

query.description: An article title or a few words naming the subject (required; an empty body answers the published example)

name: wiki_summary

asOf.description: ISO time the search and the summary were read (the older of them)

attribution.description: The credit to keep beside any reuse of the text, with the article's link

coordinates.description: The subject's coordinates when the article has them, or null

defaulted.description: Present only when the body was empty: which query the answer is for, and why

description.description: The short description (usually Wikidata's), or null

extract.description: The article's lead section as plain text (at most 4,000 characters) — Wikipedia contributors' text

lastModified.description: ISO time of the article's last edit, or null

license.description: The license of the text (CC BY-SA 4.0)

matchedBy.description: How the article was chosen: exact title, full-text search or title search

matchedTitle.description: The redirect or alias title that matched, when it differs from the article's title (e.g. HTTP 402 → List of HTTP status codes)

note.description: Whose text it is, how the article was chosen, and the limits

otherMatches.description: Up to 4 other titles the search returned

thumbnail.description: The article's lead image (https), or null

type.description: standard, disambiguation (a list of meanings, not an answer), mainpage, no-extract, or unknown

title: Wikipedia article summary (21 languages) ($0.0018)
